stage.label: Fetch bytes
stage.does: The host (JavaScript in a worker, or Deno) fetches the page and its stylesheets. It reads no markup.

stage.label: XSLT
stage.does: An XML page that names a stylesheet with <?xml-stylesheet?> is transformed. Version 1.x runs in XSLT/, versions 2.0 to 4.0 in XSLT4/. This page went through this stage.

stage.label: Parse HTML
stage.does: The WHATWG tokenizer and tree builder make a DOM arena.

stage.label: Scripts
stage.does: QuickJS runs page scripts in a separate heap. A script changes the DOM only through typed commands that Lean checks and applies.

stage.label: Style
stage.does: CSS rules are matched and cascaded into computed styles, for a bounded block, inline and table profile.

stage.label: Fonts and shaping
stage.does: Lean reads the font files (Noto Sans, with Noto Sans Armenian as a fallback), substitutes and positions glyphs, and takes the outlines.

stage.label: Layout
stage.does: Block flow, inline word wrapping and table layout give each box its place.

stage.label: SVG geometry
stage.does: Paths, curves, strokes, dashes, gradients and transforms become triangles and paint.

stage.label: Paint list
stage.does: Every box, glyph and shape goes into one list of painted primitives.

stage.label: GPU plan
stage.does: Lean writes the WebGPU buffers, the WGSL shader and every command in order.

stage.label: WebGPU draw
stage.does: The host submits the commands that Lean wrote. It makes no layout or paint decision.
